title: Well and Visitor
author: Xanthe Kavanagh
blurb: Noor Dunmore, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
